en: Black‑and‑white/sepia postcard showing a brick building and several simple barracks‑style wooden houses in the background. In the foreground stands a group of Austro‑Hungarian military officers in uniform, some holding or wearing sabres, one saluting. A man in civilian clothes stands at the steps of the brick building. German text in red print at the upper right refers to Exzellenz Albert von Koller, corps commander and commanding general of the 8th Corps at the k.u.k. military camp Milowitz.
